Relief shown by hachures. Prime meridian: Ferro. "To Sir William Young, Bart. ... this plan of the island of St. Vincent ... John Byres." Shows land granted to the Caribs, treaty boundaries, and boundaries of salable lands. Includes explanatory text. Scale ca. 1:32,000. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. Vault AACR2
